settings_general_git_none_of_writernames: None of {writerNames} is installed on this computer, so there is nothing to write messages yet. Install one and pick it here.
settings_general_git_the_staged_diff_all: The staged diff (all changes when nothing is staged) goes only to the agent you pick here, run on this computer with no tools, plus your recent commit subjects and the commit rules of CONTRIBUTING.md and AGENTS.md. Files that look like secrets (.env, keys, certificates) are never sent; lockfiles and binaries are sent as names only. Choose Off to hide the button.
